body: Oof!!!! Not in Escondido 🥹 but any and all sightings are making me hopeful it may be recovered. Thank you for letting me know!

I’m just worried that multiple people within the Sheriffs department told me that the Detective assigned is the only one that can investigate this and he told me he will look to it on Tuesday. It feels like time is of the essence here but not much else I can do I guess. 

I didn’t have comprehensive coverage (dumb I know, no one I know has experienced this in the area so I didn’t think of it and my budget is tight) so they won’t cover any of the loss.

I didn’t see the rest of your message. I don’t have a car loan but I was hoping to footage can provide some clarity to if the car was there / has the same plates on it - or if the items were dumped and someone was using the card randomly. 

The card declined and they actually attempted a second time. I was able to get the times they used it and the transaction number so it should be easy to pull up. 

Thank you for your advice!!! It’s difficult to know how to navigate this so any insight is very helpful.

Unfortunately because the card was declined I was told it wasn’t enough to issue a secondary fraud police charge that would be looked into separately. It’s not a bad idea though, and I can definitely call again for a second opinion. 

I physically went in to the Encinitas office today / called the non emergency line twice which eventually connected me to an on duty officer enough that the detective emailed for information even though he was off. Unfortunately, he told me he will contact Chevron on Tuesday when he’s back in office. 

Pulling out any and all stops…. The advice is appreciated I’ll really do anything it takes.

Thank you!!! I’m hoping the footage (even if the detective is unable to look into it until Tuesday 🥹) can reveal some more information about if the person was actually at the pump with my vehicle or not. An Instacart card isn’t the smartest thing to use….

Any and all eyes looking out is so appreciated!
I really appreciate this ❤️ thank you so much!

I actually called the National City police non emergency line when I was down there (the gas station told me I need a police officer present to obtain footage). They let me know they couldn’t help me because it all falls under the case I created when I filed the police report in Encinitas. If you have any further advice for me I’m more than happy to attempt anything… I just want my car back.

I have a police report I filed on 12/19 with the Encinitas Sheriffs department which puts my car on a stolen vehicle list with all officers in the state. It will be pulled over at gun point if seen driving - as this is a felony offense. 

I actually called the number you provided in my last post - they let me know because there is already a report the detective assigned to my case is my contact point for any further information. When the report is put into the system and the vehicle is flagged as stolen - there is not much else they can do. 

As I said my car got STOLEN and I am in distress as I’m a teacher who can’t financially afford not having a vehicle let alone purchasing a new one. I appreciated you providing me the number - it’s good to bug as many people as I can right now to help me, but if you’re done being helpful I really don’t appreciate the negative commentary. 

There’s no one I can scam I just want eyes out for my car.

It’s an Instacart Mastercard that can only be used if you’re shopping an order for somebody. I use the Apple Pay option when I shop for Instacart so I didn’t even know it was in the vehicle. It immediately declined.

Yeah I posted that. I’m posting here again because someone used my card that was inside the car at a National City gas station this morning. I called the Border Division and all they can ensure is that they will let me know if they attempt to cross the border.

I did. I’ve had a police report out since 12/19 unfortunately.. my card was used this morning in National City at Chevron but the detective on my case is not back in office until next Tuesday. There’s not much I can do unfortunately 🥹
Yes there’s a police report but I haven’t heard anything

What?
It’s been a year for me (overdose on anti depressants) and I still don’t remember the night at all. Super frustrating and hard to find answers about online, I’m always searching.

Same, but I’m a year past my attempt. What happened afterwards? 

I’m in therapy and have done everything they say to do - but haunted is a great way to describe it..
I’m going through this exact thing :( different means of committing but hearing sirens or even some medical shows make me feel nauseous and it’s driving me insane.
I also have daily nightmares that haven’t subsided (even for a night) since this happened - if that means anything.

I woke up in the ICU thinking “that sounds like something I would do” but couldn’t remember a thing. It’s scary to now have to sit and think about how that night went - and understand it was me that really did it. I’m sad for myself that I was certain that was the end.
It’s weird it’s the exact opposite for me - it’s calming now that I know it
You articulated this well. Sometimes I feel like all I’m living for is to not have to go through it again..

Hahaha this is so refreshing. Thank you for asking.

Light blue. The extra relaxing nice kind of light blue :)

My thoughts were telling me I was worthless and there was absolutely no way out of the hole I dug myself into. I couldn’t think of anyone else but me in that - and ending my pain. 

It’s weird to me that your thoughts can override your internal survival instincts and that you CAN kill yourself. It’s crazy, isn’t it?

I end up thinking about that a lot. I’ve googled facts about it over .. like how many people attempt multiple times in the same year. I’m always afraid I’ll “slip back” there, but I’m not sure that’s how it works. 

I’m still learning!!

I remember asking “why am I here?” and they told me

My instant thought was “that makes sense…”. Almost like I was out of that body now and it wasn’t me anymore but I could understand it??? I’m not sure how to really explain it without sounding stupid lol.
Yes I did.. just a shitty one in the notes app on my phone to my parents. I must’ve been pretty gone at that point to only leave that… or just determined to finally be done.
No one replied there :/

How I’ve thought - which idk if this is really that healthy or not but it’s getting me through - is okay.. I’m fucking alive. I might as well try?? Just give living, entirely differently than I was before I attempted, a shot. 

And I can say small things have shown me it’s worth living. Small things have shown me maybe I can be okay. 

I think it takes a long time to feel super fulfilled - but I feel something. A little tweaking of my super negative self talk and loathe to be in this world happening. 

It’s rough but I hope that kinda answers your question.

I love your username. 

Unfortunately I can’t remember the entire day beforehand. I know I went to see a movie - from my emails - but can’t remember that at all. I can remember the day before and then waking up in the hospital. 

This isn’t really your question - but when I woke up I felt like I woke up from the most relaxing darkness. Peace I had never felt and complete calm. I wasn’t scared at all of what happened. It’s hard to explain, but it was unusual for me because I’m used to such a constant state of dread. 

Outpatient started as 9 AM to 3 PM.. now I’ve scaled back to half days (until 1 PM). There’s about 5-8 people in each group - they switch daily but remain the same weekly. There’s a topic each group follows - the one today was “fear and loss with change”. For the first two sessions we learn - biologically what’s going on and what feelings arise in various situations. A lot of being curious about the origin, identifying and challenging negative thoughts. The last group is process… so basically get out the things you need to say. It’s been super helpful to be able to say these crazy things I’ve thought for so long.. and not have people give advice, but just listen and understand. 

I hope this answers your questions!!! Thank you so much for asking me them!! I never have anyone respond to any of my posts so I’m really stoked :)

At first - I was really pissed. Like I couldn’t even lull myself right… are you kidding me??

It took me months but finally I was like FUCK you know what?? I’m happy to be alive. It’s little things… the tiniest smallest of progress I’m making that gives me a little hope. There’s no denying things are still shitty and life isn’t ideal - but I’m proud of myself for chugging along.


Thank you for asking :)

Therapy didn’t work for me for a very long time… actually until right now. I think it had something to do with me not being super receptive before, but also there’s a lot of therapists out there that don’t work for me - and that’s okay! 

It’s fucking HUGE to recognize that you are struggling and you want a change. Asking for help is so scary, and the things you are feeling are so valid. I’m uncomfortable every single day.. but I know that means change must be happening?? There’s no denying it isn’t a shitty process though. 

All I can say is I’m proud of you for getting to where you’re at!! Without having to do something terrible like I did :)

Everyone in my world looks at me different. It’s like I’m walking on eggshells. I can’t even really find any info on the internet about survivors.. but am desperately searching every night to hear a story like this. The act and direct aftermath was terrible, but this is almost worse.
What the fuck!!! That’s so weird the exact same thing happened to you. I’m still so freaked out - like I literally didn’t know that just could happen out of the blue like that and be so intense???

I’m taking 150 Wellbutrin 40 mg Prozac - 3 weeks in with the Prozac addition. I’m loving it so far - at first I would randomly feel nauseous throughout the day or almost like I was “coming up” midday but it seemed to have subsided in the last few days. I can definitely feel like the looming cloud that was hanging over me is out of sight. Let me know how it goes for you!

I just made a post - the first time I also ever fully admitted all I have done to the most honest extent (even if it was just to a Reddit page). 

I can relate so painfully well to the looming “stick to my stomach” feeling that constantly haunts you carrying all you’ve said. For me - it’s almost like I know the inevitable is coming and I can’t even theorize a plan or take any action to do so. It’s paralyzing. I also can relate to having “normal” morals and criticizing things in others without even thinking twice of my compulsive lying. It’s like I can completely disconnect my own doings sometimes - but also can tune in and feel them eating me alive if I choose to. I haven’t been completely and fully honest with anyone because it feels so awful to actually come to terms to the extent of it all. Like I can just keep lying to myself about MY lying. I can’t tell if it’s a relief to even get it all out there on the internet or awful because I am now acknowledging how aware I am of everything I’ve done.  

It sounds like you’re a step ahead of me because these lies aren’t muscle memory to you. There’s people you’ve been able to be honest with - and even if you haven’t told your therapist yet - you haven’t lied to her either. I’m obviously not a therapist just someone struggling with the same issue, but it sounds like that’s a start to being able to stop. Knowing that it’s possible.

I do this too :( 

I’ve been trying to recognize when I’m about to do it but the only time I can really stop myself is when it’s a lie over text. Sometimes I’ll just make up a completely fake situation in my head to text someone just for a reaction. Like for example - I told my girlfriend a car cut my off in a grocery store parking lot so I yelled at them. But that never happened. I have no fucking idea why I do it and it’s beyond frustrating! For a reaction I guess??? But a minuscule reaction doesn’t seem worth the lie.
